answer: Reputation decays five percent per idle epoch and resets to zero whenever an identity links a second wallet. Each submission keeps a body hash on chain, so a reused answer matches a stored hash and the link is caught by replay, not by name. Ten thousand clones restart every score at that first link test. The operator pays for unique work per alias per dawn, and the budget breaks before the detection does. A farm looks like an oasis once, then the karst under it is all dead accounts.
